svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How Siphon serves several streams
svg.text: Serving several streams on one GPU

g.text: A alone: the draft guesses, one pass verifies.
B arrives and prefills in chunks. A keeps decoding.
B joins the batch: one row per stream in each step.
C arrives and pages run short. B waits in host RAM.
C finishes. B comes back where it stopped.
A alone again: back to speculation.
